# scamp Provider

Terraform provider for managing SCAMP cloud resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    scamp = {
      source  = "serverscamp/scamp"
      version = "~> 1.4"
    }
  }
}

# The token is created in the Cloud Panel under API tokens and shown once.
# Prefer the environment variable: SCAMP_TOKEN=sc_...
provider "scamp" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_url` (String) Base API URL (default: https://platform.serverscamp.com/api/v1). Can also be set via SCAMP_API_URL env var.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API token (starts with sc_). Can also be set via SCAMP_TOKEN env var.
